name: print-social-carousel-navy-red-ai-face-glitch-photo
title: Navy/red AI carousel with glitched face-splash photography
whatItIs: An eight-tile Instagram grid on a deep navy background, repeating a heavily glitch/color-splashed portrait photo (red-blue channel split) alongside bold '80% We are the future' statistic headlines.
whatItMeans: A single dramatically distorted portrait reused across every tile, rather than eight different photos, keeps production simple while still filling a whole grid with striking, on-theme imagery.
techniques: reuse one heavily stylized hero photo across every tile of a grid instead of sourcing new imagery each time
apply a strong red/blue channel-split glitch treatment to signal 'AI/digital' distortion
pair a single large percentage stat with a short bold claim for an easily quotable headline tile

vocabulary.definition: offsetting an image's red, green and blue color channels from each other to create a distorted, digital look
